name: The Ravalgaon Sugar Farm Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1003, The Ravalgaon 
Sugar Farm Ltd is in the business 
of manufacturing of Confectionery 
products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
TRSFL manufactures various Confectionery Products viz. hard-boiled sweets which are die-formed, with the option of soft centre fillings. They are wrapped using double-twist, single-twist and flow pack (pillow pouch) techniques.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.

Company has a low return on equity of -36.8% over last 3 years.
